reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A knowledge URL capture now has a 120 s total deadline (redirects, body chunks and rendered page resources), and the route waits for its fetch thread at most that long plus 30 s, so a trickling server can no longer hold the project's work lane for years.
